explanation: It is 0 almost everywhere: at every GO and D2 step, at every D1 that follows a rewarded trial, and at all D1 steps before about trial 80 of the episode. It turns on only at D1 after an unrewarded trial late in the episode (about trials 82-97) while the agent has been picking a2, where it is usually 7-10 (often 10), but it can drop to 0 after a long run of losses or in the last few trials (95+).
